actions.name: luring song
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sings a magical melody, which lasts until the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Concentration ends on it. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=dxxqZP7Vo01te3QB]], each [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=dxxqZP7Vo01te3QB]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dxxqZP7Vo01te3QB]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} when the song starts. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition until the song ends and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. While Charmed, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition and ignores the Luring Song of other harpies. If the target is more than 5 feet from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the target moves on its turn toward the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. It doesn't avoid &Reference[OpportunityAttacks]; however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the target repeats the save. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Luring Song for 24 hours.
